pre_command:
osascript -e 'tell application "Numbers" to quit' && sleep 2 && rm -f ~/Documents/complete_financial_report.xlsx && printf 'Category,Amount,Date
Income,5000,2025-01-01
Salary,4500,2025-01-15
Bonus,500,2025-01-30' > ~/Documents/finance_overview.csv && printf 'Expense,Amount,Category,Date
Rent,1200,Housing,2025-01-01
Groceries,300,Food,2025-01-05
Utilities,150,Housing,2025-01-10
Gas,80,Transportation,2025-01-12
Insurance,200,Healthcare,2025-01-15' > ~/Documents/expenses_detail.csv
instruction: Merge two existing documents in Numbers: 'finance_overview.csv' and 'expenses_detail.csv', combine their tables into a master overview table, and save it as 'complete_financial_report.xlsx' in the Documents folder.
evaluator: [ -f ~/Documents/complete_financial_report.xlsx ] && [ -s ~/Documents/complete_financial_report.xlsx ] && python3 -c "import zipfile,os,sys; path=os.path.expanduser('~/Documents/complete_financial_report.xlsx'); z=zipfile.ZipFile(path); content=' '.join([z.read(f).decode('utf-8','ignore').lower() for f in z.namelist() if f.endswith('.xml') or f.endswith('.iwa')]); finance_terms=['income','salary','bonus','rent','groceries','utilities']; found_terms=sum(1 for term in finance_terms if term in content); sys.exit(0 if found_terms>=4 else 1)" 2>/dev/null && echo True || echo False
